responsibility: Defines the compiler-internal data model and public API for GCC’s CTF container, the shared intermediate representation used to emit both CTF and BTF debug formats. The header declares the core type, variable, member, function-argument, encoding, slice, array, string-table, and container structures, the per-translation-unit container handle, constants and flags for type IDs and root/nonroot visibility, and the interfaces for container lifecycle, type/variable insertion and lookup, string management, source-location queries, CTF/BTF emission entry points, and DWARF-driven type construction helpers used by dwarf2ctf.cc and the output back ends.
same_name_distinction: Declares the CTF container representation and public compiler-facing API that ctfc.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file’s runtime management code, this header is the shared type/interface contract used by DWARF-to-CTF translation and the CTF/BTF emitters.
